Method of Attack: Distributed via malspam emails disguised as official BSI messages
Emails contain ZIP attachments with Windows shortcut camouflaged as PDF
Shortcut launches remote HTA file via PowerShell command
Uses Living off the Land tactic with mshta.exe to avoid detection
Downloads ransomware payload from malicious domain
Deletes shadow volume copies and disables Windows startup repair
Encrypts files with unique extensions and creates ransom notes
Ransom payment demanded via Bitcoin on Tor payment site
Impacted Systems: Systems vulnerable to Oracle WebLogic critical vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Windows binaries: mshta.exe, cmd.exe, vssadmin.exe, bcdedit
Bitcoin payment addresses on Tor payment site
